explication: NocoDB is a web-based database builder. The main user-facing path is working with database tables and rows in the GUI; the backend exposes data APIs and manages relationships. The repository also includes query-filter parsing and integration/object-storage capabilities. The README establishes the product’s database-building purpose, while the graph’s internal edges rely on the supplied source excerpts and SOURCE INDEX; unsampled connections are not asserted.
